title: MiR-30a-5p mediates epileptogenesis in epilepsy models by targeting SOX4 to regulate the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway.
authors: Yang, Zhenlin; Zhang, Xu; Guo, Jingjing; Wei, Yuanxin; Li, Jinzi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究miR-30a-5p通过靶向SOX4调控Wnt/β-catenin通路影响癫痫突触可塑性，核心是miRNA-mRNA互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅提及分子动力学但未实际应用，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: The pathogenesis of epilepsy is closely associated with neuronal synaptic plasticity. MicroRNAs (miRNAs) can regulate various biological processes by binding to specific sequences on target genes. This study employs bioinformatics, molecular dynamics, and experimental approaches to investigate the mechanism by which MiR-30a-5p treats epilepsy through targeting SOX4 and regulating the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway. METHODS: Performed bioinformatics analysis to predict the signaling pathways involved in miRNA-30a-5p-mediated intervention in epilepsy. RT-qPCR was used to detect the expression levels of miR-30a-5p in the hippocampal tissues of epileptic rats and in primary hippocampal neurons subjected to Mg(2+)-free treatment. The effects of miR-30a-5p inhibition on synaptic plasticity were assessed using EEG, the Morris water maze test, Golgi staining, Sholl analysis, and Western blotting. TargetScan and miRTarBase were employed to predict the target genes of miR-30a-5p. The interaction was validated through dual-luciferase reporter assays, IHC, IF, and Western blotting, and the effect of SOX4 inhibition on synaptic plasticity was evaluated. The involvement of the Wnt signaling pathway was assessed by Western blotting. RESULTS: The expression level of miR-30a-5p was significantly elevated in the hippocampal region of epileptic rats and in magnesium-depleted hippocampal neuronal cultures. SOX4 was identified as a direct target of miR-30a-5p. Inhibiting miR-30a-5p reduces the expression of synapse-associated proteins (SYP/CaMKII/PSD95), while upregulating SOX4 and downregulating the levels of Wnt3a, beta-catenin, and cyclin D1. miR-30a-5p may participate in alterations of neuronal synaptic plasticity by directly targeting and inhibiting SOX4 expression, thereby activating the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway. SIGNIFICANCE: This study provides evidence that miR-30a-5p participates in the process of synaptic plasticity impairment in epileptic neurons. The study confirms a direct interaction between miR-30a-5p and SOX4. Furthermore, miR-30a-5p regulates the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway by targeting SOX4, thereby influencing neuronal synaptic plasticity impairment. This discovery provides a novel potential therapeutic target for delaying epilepsy progression. PLAIN LANGUAGE SUMMARY: Epilepsy is a common brain disorder that affects millions of people worldwide. This study found that a small molecule called miR-30a-5p increases in the brain during epilepsy and disrupts normal communication between neurons. By blocking this molecule in laboratory experiments, we were able to improve neuron function and reduce damage. These findings suggest that targeting miR-30a-5p could lead to new treatments to slow down the progression of epilepsy.
abstract_zh: 目的：癫痫的发病机制与神经元突触可塑性密切相关。微小RNA（miRNAs）可通过与靶基因上的特定序列结合来调控多种生物过程。本研究采用生物信息学、分子动力学及实验方法，探讨MiR-30a-5p通过靶向SOX4并调控Wnt/β-catenin信号通路治疗癫痫的机制。方法：进行生物信息学分析以预测miRNA-30a-5p介导的癫痫干预所涉及的信号通路。采用RT-qPCR检测癫痫大鼠海马组织及无Mg(2+)处理的原代海马神经元中miR-30a-5p的表达水平。通过脑电图、Morris水迷宫测试、高尔基染色、Sholl分析和Western blotting评估miR-30a-5p抑制对突触可塑性的影响。采用TargetScan和miRTarBase预测miR-30a-5p的靶基因。通过双荧光素酶报告基因实验、免疫组化（IHC）、免疫荧光（IF）和Western blotting验证相互作用，并评估SOX4抑制对突触可塑性的影响。通过Western blotting评估Wnt信号通路的参与情况。结果：在癫痫大鼠海马区域及镁缺乏的海马神经元培养中，miR-30a-5p的表达水平显著升高。SOX4被鉴定为miR-30a-5p的直接靶标。抑制miR-30a-5p可降低突触相关蛋白（SYP/CaMKII/PSD95）的表达，同时上调SOX4并下调Wnt3a、β-catenin和cyclin D1的水平。miR-30a-5p可能通过直接靶向并抑制SOX4表达，从而激活Wnt/β-catenin信号通路，参与神经元突触可塑性的改变。意义：本研究提供了miR-30a-5p参与癫痫神经元突触可塑性损伤过程的证据。研究确认了miR-30a-5p与SOX4之间的直接相互作用。此外，miR-30a-5p通过靶向SOX4调控Wnt/β-catenin信号通路，从而影响神经元突触可塑性损伤。这一发现为延缓癫痫进展提供了新的潜在治疗靶点。简明语言摘要：癫痫是一种常见的脑部疾病，影响全球数百万人。本研究发现，在癫痫发作期间，大脑中一种名为miR-30a-5p的小分子水平升高，并干扰神经元之间的正常通讯。在实验室实验中阻断该分子后，我们能够改善神经元功能并减少损伤。这些发现表明，靶向miR-30a-5p可能为减缓癫痫进展提供新的治疗方法。
